blurb: Guests play laser tag in a large multi-level LED illuminated arena with up to 46 players. They can also enjoy axe throwing with laser projectors and automatic scoring, and play Krazy Darts with a giant target board and multiple games. Food and drink options include pizza, deli, hot buffets, appetizers, wings, pizza, and a full bar with specialty cocktails and local draft beers.
